entries.claim: Apply relative-only ±15% G8 verifier-cost parity to every domain including sub-millisecond MATH normalizer costs.
entries.reason: Behavioral verification audit Axis 1 measured MATH TOOL_COMPUTE medians near 0.09 ms where relative ±15% is below timer-stable resolution.
evidence: AFTER-THE-FACT AMENDMENT: G8 band rule was changed mid-audit after relative-only ±15% converted MATH/TEXT_TO_SQL into FAIL. This is a process wound against pre-registration discipline; it is ledgered rather than silent. Justification is instrument physics (timer resolution / within-harness IQR), not convenience, and CODE-class relative ±15% was preserved.
protocol amendment: G8 half_width = max(0.15 * median, 0.25 ms absolute, max within-harness IQR)
relative ±15% alone is below timer/SQLite open noise for MATH (~0.09 ms) and TEXT_TO_SQL (~1 ms with IQR > band)
material CODE TOOL_COMPUTE (~80 ms) still governed by relative ±15% when it exceeds the floors
STANDING PRINCIPLE: any future gate over sub-millisecond quantities must freeze a timer-resolution floor at protocol freeze time, not at failure time (MCP-01 Windows tick lesson).
